name: SeerrNG
description: Self-hosted requests and discovery for movies, TV, music, books, comics, magazines, ROMs, and PC games, with optional integrations including BookshelfNG, Mylar3, Kapowarr, LazyLibrarian, ROMarrNG, and QuestarrNG.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent database, settings, logs, image cache, and TLS material. Make this host directory writable by UID 1000 and GID 1000.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the SeerrNG web interface.

ports.name: HTTPS Port
ports.description: HTTPS listener port when built-in TLS is enabled in Settings > Network.

variables.name: TMDB API Key Override
variables.description: Optional override. SeerrNG includes a default TMDB key; leave blank unless you need to use your own v3 API key.

variables.name: TMDB Read Access Token Override
variables.description: Optional v4 bearer-token override. SeerrNG includes a default TMDB key; leave blank unless you need to use your own token. This takes precedence over the v3 API key override.

variables.name: Metrics Enabled
variables.description: Set to true to enable the Prometheus /metrics endpoint.

variables.name: Metrics Auth Token
variables.description: Optional bearer token required by /metrics when metrics are enabled.

variables.name: Require Public Setup Hosts
variables.description: Set to true to reject private or LAN Jellyfin and Emby hostnames during first-run setup.

variables.name: Allow Private Notification URLs
variables.description: Set to true only when notification receivers such as Discord, Slack, webhooks, ntfy, or Gotify are intentionally hosted on the LAN.

variables.name: Allow Private Push Endpoints
variables.description: Set to true only when browser push subscription endpoints are intentionally private or internal.

variables.name: External Services Read Only
variables.description: Set to true to block mutating requests to external automation services. Production also requires the explicit production override below.

variables.name: Allow Production Read Only
variables.description: Explicitly allows read-only external-service mode in production when SEERR_EXTERNAL_READ_ONLY is true.

variables.name: Skip Database Migrations
variables.description: Set to true only when database migrations are run out of band.
